recognize_zh: EBER 原位雜交高倍圖：在淡粉紅色對比染色的背景下，許多腫瘤細胞核呈深藍黑色訊號，細胞質不著色，表示 EBV 感染腫瘤細胞。
features: Densely cellular infiltrate with pink/red counterstain
Numerous nuclei with dark blue-black EBER signal, varying in intensity
Signal confined to nuclei; cytoplasm and stroma unstained
Positive cells include intermediate and large atypical forms
Section shows some crush/processing artifact that limits crispness
describe_en: EBER in situ hybridization shows nuclear signal in a large proportion of the neoplastic cells, with dark blue-black staining confined to nuclei against a pink counterstain. Positive cells include larger atypical forms, indicating EBV infection of the tumor rather than scattered bystander lymphocytes, although some processing artifact reduces sharpness. In a transplant recipient with a CD20-negative, MUM1-positive, light-chain-restricted plasma cell proliferation, findings are consistent with EBV-positive plasmacytoma-like post-transplant lymphoproliferative disorder.

ddx.vs: Conventional plasma cell neoplasms are typically EBER-negative, whereas diffuse tumor-cell EBER favors PTLD.

ddx.dx: Reactive lesion with scattered EBV-positive bystanders
ddx.vs: Bystander EBV infection shows only rare positive small lymphocytes, not signal in the majority of the atypical cells.
PEL is often EBER-positive too but is defined by HHV8/LANA nuclear positivity.
